screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in elective aortic surgery assessing blood loss and transfusion. Matches RCT, perioperative DDAVP versus placebo; no inherited bleeding disorder focus.
Double-blind randomized study of DDAVP versus placebo in total hip replacement with perioperative administration and blood loss outcomes. Meets RCT criteria.
Secondary research (meta-analysis), not a primary randomized controlled trial comparing DDAVP to a comparator in a single study.
Randomized comparative trial with DDAVP arms versus aprotinin and no-treatment controls in CPB surgery; perioperative administration and bleeding/transfusion outcomes. Fits inclusion.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in CABG patients; perioperative DDAVP versus placebo with bleeding outcomes. Fits inclusion.
Randomized two-group study of DDAVP versus no DDAVP in bimaxillary osteotomy assessing blood loss/hematocrit; perioperative administration; no inherited bleeding disorder focus.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in elective cardiac surgery; DDAVP given to those with abnormal hemoSTATUS; reports bleeding and transfusion. Meets inclusion.

Perioperative comparison of DDAVP versus saline after hydroxyethyl starch infusion, focusing on vWF activity. Randomization not explicit and bleeding outcomes not primary, but perioperative DDAVP versus control in surgical patients; include conservatively.
Guideline summary unrelated to DDAVP randomized perioperative trials; not a primary RCT.
Double-blind randomized trial of DDAVP versus placebo in total hip replacement with dextran; perioperative administration; bleeding/transfusion outcomes. Meets criteria.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in CPB patients with postoperative bleeding; perioperative DDAVP; assesses blood loss and blood products. Fits inclusion.
Patients were divided into DDAVP versus control during valvular surgery; perioperative administration with bleeding and transfusion outcomes. Randomization not explicit; include conservatively.

Randomized controlled trial comparing DDAVP to active transfusion in an invasive procedure (dental extraction) among cirrhotic patients (acquired coagulopathy, not inherited). Relevant peri-procedural comparison.
Double-blind randomized trial in total joint arthroplasty; perioperative DDAVP versus placebo; bleeding and transfusion endpoints. Meets inclusion.

Small comparative perioperative study in aspirin-treated cholecystectomy patients; DDAVP given to a subset. Randomization not stated but directly examines perioperative DDAVP effect; include conservatively.
Randomized clinical trial of DDAVP versus saline in endoscopic sinus surgery with bleeding and surgical field outcomes. Fits inclusion.
Randomized, double-blinded, controlled trial in spinal fusion; perioperative DDAVP; reduced blood loss and transfusions reported. Meets inclusion.
Double-blind randomized trial in cardiac surgery patients on aspirin; DDAVP versus placebo; transfusion requirements assessed. Meets inclusion.
Double-blind randomized three-arm study (aprotinin, DDAVP, placebo) in CPB surgery; bleeding and transfusion outcomes. Fits inclusion.

Randomized, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo after CABG; perioperative administration with hemodynamic effects and blood loss reported. Relevant RCT even though primary outcome is hemodynamics.
Randomized, double-blind, prospective trial in 100 CPB patients; DDAVP versus placebo; intraoperative and postoperative blood loss and transfusions assessed. Meets criteria.
Double-blind study comparing DDAVP to placebo in spinal fusion for neuromuscular scoliosis; perioperative dosing and blood loss outcomes. Fits inclusion.
Randomized, double-blind trial in routine CABG; perioperative DDAVP versus placebo with bleeding and transfusion outcomes. Meets inclusion.
Systematic review of transfusion thresholds, not a primary RCT of desmopressin versus comparator in surgical settings.
Methodological paper on bias detection in meta-analyses; not a clinical RCT of DDAVP.
Prospective blinded randomized study in elective CABG comparing DDAVP (single/repeat) versus placebo with perioperative blood loss and blood product use outcomes; fits RCT perioperative criteria.

Double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial after CPB in primary CABG assessing postoperative blood loss and red cell transfusion; meets RCT perioperative criteria without inherited bleeding disorders.
Double-blind randomized study in cardiac surgery comparing DDAVP vs placebo with outcomes including blood loss and replacement volume; RCT, perioperative setting.
Letter/comment regarding lumbar puncture and sedation practices; not a randomized trial of DDAVP for perioperative bleeding or transfusion outcomes.
Randomized blinded comparison in pediatric cardiac operations evaluating 24-hour blood loss and replacement; RCT, perioperative, non-inherited bleeding cohort.

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel-group trial subset in uncomplicated CABG assessing vWF, platelet aggregation, bleeding time, and postoperative blood loss; qualifies as RCT in surgical setting.
Retrospective cohort of patients declining transfusion; no DDAVP intervention and not randomized; outside scope of RCTs of DDAVP in surgery.
Randomized trial of DDAVP for thromboprophylaxis after transvenous catheterization; primary outcome is venous thrombosis, not perioperative blood loss or transfusion.
Double-blind randomized controlled trial of pre-biopsy DDAVP vs placebo to reduce bleeding complications after percutaneous kidney biopsy; invasive procedure context, appropriate outcomes.
Guideline on von Willebrand disease (an inherited bleeding disorder); not an RCT and population outside review scope.
Double-blind randomized clinical trial in major scoliosis surgery evaluating blood loss and coagulation factors; RCT perioperative study.

Randomized double-blind trial in total hip arthroplasty (RA patients) comparing two DDAVP doses vs placebo with outcomes including total blood loss and red cell transfusion; matches inclusion criteria.

Study in cardiac surgery patients with aspirin-induced platelet dysfunction evaluating DDAVP to reduce blood loss/transfusion; perioperative, acquired (not inherited) dysfunction; likely randomized; include for full-text verification.
Narrative review of DDAVP in various hematologic and surgical contexts; not a primary randomized controlled trial.
News/summary piece about a biopsy trial; not the primary RCT report; excludes at title/abstract screening as non-primary study.
Review on transfusion reactions (prevention, diagnosis, treatment); not a DDAVP RCT in perioperative settings.
Placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial of preoperative DDAVP to reduce blood loss in burn debridement/grafting; perioperative RCT with bleeding outcomes.
Double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial in elective cardiac surgery examining postoperative blood loss and blood product use; aligns with RCT inclusion criteria.
National survey of RBC utilization; observational descriptive study, not an RCT of DDAVP.
Large registry analysis of CABG reoperation for bleeding; observational risk modeling; not a DDAVP RCT.
Guideline on platelet transfusions; not a randomized trial and not evaluating DDAVP perioperatively.

Multicenter randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP vs placebo in actively bleeding post–cardiac surgery patients pre-treated with tranexamic acid; outcome includes RBC transfusion; fits criteria.
Methods paper on funnel plot asymmetry and bias in meta-analyses; not a clinical RCT of DDAVP.
Mechanistic review on cellular actions of DDAVP; not a randomized clinical trial in perioperative settings.
Randomized prospective double-blind trial in major flap reconstruction for pelvic pressure sores assessing intraoperative blood loss and transfusions with DDAVP vs placebo; perioperative RCT.
Randomized, double-blind perioperative CABG trial of DDAVP vs placebo; reports transfusion/blood loss outcomes.
Bernard–Soulier syndrome (inherited bleeding disorder) mechanistic/single-patient context; not a perioperative RCT.
Guideline for hereditary bleeding disorders; not a primary randomized perioperative trial.
Nonrandomized observational CABG cohort; DDAVP administered to a subset; does not meet RCT criterion.
Society guideline update on blood conservation; not a primary RCT of DDAVP.
Stratified meta-analysis of DDAVP; secondary research, not a primary RCT.
Meta-analysis of prophylactic drugs (incl. DDAVP); not a primary perioperative RCT.
Narrative review of alternatives to platelet transfusion; not a randomized perioperative DDAVP trial.
Prospective, single-blind perioperative comparative study in TKR: tranexamic acid vs desmopressin; active comparator design fits criteria though randomization not explicit.
Single-arm series of uremic patients before emergent procedures; no randomized comparator.
Randomized DDAVP vs saline in uremic patients measuring closure time before hemodialysis; not clearly perioperative/invasive procedure outcomes (bleeding/transfusion).
Before–after neurosurgical cohort using PFA-100 with prophylactic DDAVP; not randomized.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind pediatric cardiac surgery RCT of DDAVP vs placebo assessing postoperative blood loss.
Randomized, placebo-controlled TKR study with DDAVP, tranexamic acid, and saline arms; perioperative RCT, includes transfusion outcomes.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled adult cardiac surgical RCT evaluating DDAVP on blood loss/transfusion.
PK/hematologic effects across administration routes; not a perioperative randomized trial.
Randomized, controlled, double-blind hepatectomy trial evaluating DDAVP effects on blood loss/transfusion.
Duplicate topic to #62 (PFA-100 neurosurgery) and nonrandomized; not a DDAVP RCT.
Double-blinded randomized cardiac surgery trial with arms including DDAVP vs placebo and tranexamic acid; perioperative RCT.
Double-blind, prospective, randomized CPB trial assessing intraoperative DDAVP vs placebo on blood loss and transfusion.
Randomized post-CPB trial of DDAVP vs placebo reporting bleeding time, blood loss, and transfusion outcomes.
Randomized, double-blind CABG study of DDAVP vs placebo; evaluates hemodynamics and postoperative blood loss.
Randomized trial where both arms receive DDAVP (with or without tranexamic acid); lacks a non-DDAVP comparator to isolate DDAVP efficacy.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of tranexamic acid; not a DDAVP randomized perioperative trial.
Consensus/recommendations on platelet function testing in neurointerventional procedures; not a DDAVP RCT.
Narrative review; not a randomized controlled trial of perioperative desmopressin.
Prospective randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of desmopressin in CABG patients; perioperative setting; appropriate comparator.
Comparative study with control group but randomization not stated; appears non-randomized; does not meet RCT criterion.
Methodological guidance document; not a clinical trial of desmopressin in a perioperative setting.
Systematic review about liver biopsy; not an RCT of desmopressin for surgery or invasive procedures.
Case series/adverse event report; not a randomized trial in a perioperative context.
Randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind perioperative trial in valvular surgery patients without inherited bleeding disorders.
Meta-analysis; not a primary RCT of desmopressin.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial in aortic valve replacement; perioperative desmopressin vs placebo.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial in vascular surgery; evaluates bleeding and transfusion.
Prospective, double-blind randomized trial in spinal fusion; perioperative desmopressin vs placebo.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind perioperative trial in congenital heart surgery patients; appropriate comparator.
Review of inherited bleeding disorder management; wrong population and not an RCT.
Guideline document; not a randomized clinical trial of perioperative desmopressin.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled perioperative trial in CABG with TEG-based subgrouping.
Phase II dose-escalation safety/tolerability study; not randomized/controlled as required by inclusion criteria.
Randomized trial in elective CABG with desmopressin vs control; perioperative context.
Meta-analysis; not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Double-blind, randomized, prospective perioperative trial of desmopressin vs placebo in CPB patients.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in aspirin-pretreated CABG patients; perioperative desmopressin.
Nonrandomized before–after cohort in cosmetic facelift; includes patients with inherited bleeding conditions; does not meet RCT criterion.
Randomized, double-blind prospective study of desmopressin vs placebo in hip replacement; perioperative setting.
Prospective randomized clinical trial in CABG; perioperative desmopressin vs placebo.
Randomized, controlled, double-blind perioperative trial in complex pediatric spinal fusion.
Meta-analysis of multiple drugs; not a primary RCT of desmopressin.
